name: io.github.shark-agents/shark-records
title: Shark Records
description: US public records for agents: insider trades (Form 4), fund holdings (13F), federal contracts. x402

tools.name: insider_trades
tools.description: Insider trades of a US-listed company from its SEC Form 4 filings (last 180 days): who, role, buy or sell, shares, average price, dates, and whether under a 10b5-1 plan with its adoption date. Price 0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402.

symbol.description: US stock ticker, for example PLTR

tools.name: federal_contracts
tools.description: US federal contracts to a company from FPDS: money obligated in the last 12 months against the 12 before, by paying agency, and the largest new awards with their ceiling and last possible end date. Price 0.05 USDC per call, paid with x402.

tools.name: fund_holdings
tools.description: What seven well-known funds (Berkshire, Duquesne, Pershing Square, Appaloosa, Baupost, Third Point, Bridgewater) held of a company at their last two 13F quarter ends, and the change. Price 0.02 USDC per call, paid with x402.

symbol.description: US stock ticker, for example PLTR
